title.zh: 跟踪内存和下一条指令
title.en: Trace Memory and the Next Instruction

concept.zh: 从一个地址读取，再写入另一个地址。
concept.en: Read from one address and write to another.

brief.zh: 逐条执行 LOAD、STORE 和 HALT，看哪些内存格读过、哪些值真的变了。
brief.en: Step through LOAD, STORE, and HALT. Check which cells were accessed and which values changed.

hints.zh: LOAD 之后，ACC 变了，源地址中的数还在。注意 STORE 执行时亮起的是哪个地址。
hints.en: After LOAD, ACC changes while the source address keeps its value. Notice which address lights up during STORE.
